content: Next, we benchmark jiant's transfer learning regime. We perform transfer experiments from MNLI to BoolQ with BERT-large. In this configuration BIBREF42 demonstrated an accuracy improvement of 0.78 to 0.82 on the dev set, and jiant achieves an improvement of 0.78 to 0.80.
